DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人が拾い、私がここへ運びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得者と持参者を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Kaibigan ko ang nakapulot at ako ang nagdala rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang nakapulot at nagdala. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際の場所を見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nakita mo ang aktuwal na lugar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いえ、駅前と聞きました。自分で見た場所とは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 場所は伝聞と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi, narinig kong sa harap ng estasyon. Hindi ko sasabihing nakita ko mismo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing narinig lamang ang lugar. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 品をこちらへお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けずに持ってきました。中身は確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封で届ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dinala ko nang hindi binubuksan. Hindi ko sinuri ang laman.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihatid nang hindi binubuksan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾った方へ連絡できますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。時刻と詳しい位置を本人に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人へ時刻位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Sa kaniya mismo ko titiyakin ang oras at eksaktong lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin sa nakapulot ang oras at lugar. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の連絡先も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itatanong din ang sarili mong kontak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 運んだ私の情報と、拾った友人の説明を分けて記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡情報の出所を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakihiwalay ang impormasyon kong nagdala at paliwanag ng kaibigang nakapulot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pinagmulan ng impormasyong pangkontak. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 品をお預かりします。拾った本人の確認事項と持参者の情報を区別して受付を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tatanggapin ang bagay. Hiwalay na ipoproseso ang dapat tiyakin sa nakapulot at impormasyon ng nagdala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旧住所へ旧姓で届きました。今の私の名前と違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧姓旧住所の郵便を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Dumating sa lumang tirahan gamit ang dati kong apelyido. Iba sa pangalan ko ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang sulat sa lumang apelyido at tirahan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。前の住人ではなく私です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧姓が本人と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, ako iyon, hindi dating nakatira.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na sarili mong dating apelyido. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 旧新の情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ang luma at bagong impormasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この資料です。封筒の名前を自分で書き換えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料を示し封筒を改変しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ito ang dokumento. Hindi ko sariling papalitan ang pangalan sa sobre.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang dokumento nang hindi binabago ang sobre. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 差出人へ変更を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Naipaalam mo ang pagbabago sa nagpadala?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所だけ伝えました。氏名の変更も別に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 差出人へ氏名変更も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tirahan lamang. Hiwalay kong ipaaalam pati pagbabago ng pangalan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaalam din ang pagbabago ng pangalan sa nagpadala. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 未開封で私が持っています。転送手続きも今の情報で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封と今後の手続きを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hawak ko nang hindi bukas. Gusto ko ring ikonsulta ang pagpapasa gamit ang kasalukuyang impormasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang hindi bukas na sulat at susunod na proseso. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人の旧姓宛て郵便として担当へ確認します。今回の郵便と今後の氏名住所変更を分けて扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin sa tauhan bilang sulat sa sarili mong dating apelyido. Hiwalay ang sulat ngayon at pagbabago ng pangalan at tirahan sa hinaharap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の携帯だけ変わりました。緊急連絡先は同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人番号だけの変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sarili kong numero ng telepono lamang ang nagbago. Pareho pa rin ang pangkagipitang kontak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing sarili mong numero lamang ang babaguhin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい番号をお願いします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。家族の番号へ全部置き換えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新番号と家族番号を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito po. Hindi ko ipapalit ang numero ng pamilya sa lahat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang bagong numero at numero ng pamilya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人確認後に担当が進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itutuloy ng tauhan matapos patunayan ang pagkakakilanlan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資料はこちらです。確認の電話が来る番号も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認資料と返答先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ito ang dokumento. Gusto ko ring itanong kung saang numero darating ang tawag ng pagpapatunay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang patunay at itanong ang tatanggap ng sagot. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回の変更欄を見ます。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人の欄だけですね。住所も同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所不変を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sarili kong bahagi lamang, tama? Pareho rin ang tirahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi nagbago ang tirahan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更結果を確認できます。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、緊急先を残した結果も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 緊急先保持の結果を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo, titiyakin ko rin na nanatili ang pangkagipitang kontak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyaking nanatili ang pangkagipitang kontak sa resulta. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人番号のみの変更として確認します。住所と緊急連絡先は変更希望なしです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin bilang sariling numero lamang. Walang hiling na baguhin ang tirahan o pangkagipitang kontak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 調理済みとありますが、食べる前に温める表示もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 調理済みと加熱案内を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nakasulat na luto na, pero may tagubiling painitin bago kainin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang luto na at gabay sa pagpainit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の手順を見ましょう。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すぐ外で食べたいので、このまま食べる品か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋外ですぐ食べる用途を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Gusto kong kainin agad sa labas, kaya titiyakin kung maaari nang kainin nang ganito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing kakainin agad sa labas. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらには加熱の案内があります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 設備がないので、自分で不要と決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 設備なしで手順を省かない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Wala akong kagamitan, kaya hindi ko sariling ipagpapasyang hindi kailangan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag laktawan ang hakbang dahil walang kagamitan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そのまま食べられる表示の物を比較したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別商品を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong ihambing ang may markang maaaring kainin agad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihambing ang ibang produkto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの商品の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tingnan ang marka ng produktong ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 希望に合います。保存条件も見て、こちら一つにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示適合品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Angkop ito. Titingnan ko rin ang pag-iimbak at kukuha ng isa nito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Piliin ang angkop ayon sa marka. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 元の商品は戻します。選んだ商品の食べ方と保存表示を残してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ibabalik ang dati. Panatilihin ang gabay sa pagkain at pag-iimbak ng napili mong produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 休憩所に水筒を忘れました。駅へ行く前に戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 置き忘れへの戻り道を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Naiwan ang lalagyan ko ng tubig sa pahingahan. Gusto kong bumalik bago mag-estasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pabalik sa naiwan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から二つ目の屋根です。青い水筒です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋根の位置と特徴を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ikalawang bubong mula sa pasukan. Asul ang lalagyan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang lugar ng bubong at katangian. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maaari kang bumalik sa daanang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰りのバスまで二十分あります。近道で柵を越えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残り時間と正規通路を使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: May dalawampung minuto bago ang bus pauwi. Hindi ako tatawid sa bakod bilang daang maikli.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang natitirang oras at gamitin ang tamang daanan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見つからなければ案内所へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung hindi makita, pumunta sa impormasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前は底にあります。ほかの青い水筒を取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 私物を目印で照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: May pangalan ko sa ilalim. Hindi ko kukunin ang ibang asul na lalagyan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itugma ang sarili mong gamit sa palatandaan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅で待っています。寄り道の時間を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者へ寄り道を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naghihintay sa estasyon. Ipaaalam ko ang oras ng pagdaan ko muna rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipaalam sa kasama ang pagdaan muna. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この通路で二つ目の屋根へ戻ってください。未発見なら底の目印を案内所へ伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito bumalik sa ikalawang bubong. Kung hindi makita, sabihin sa impormasyon ang marka sa ilalim.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 移動先はどちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: バス停です。雨で荷物が濡れるので屋根のある道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨を避ける経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa hintuan ng bus. Mababasâ ang dala sa ulan, kaya gusto ko ng may bubong na daan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng daang makaiiwas sa ulan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 屋根は途中で切れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: May putol ang bubong sa daan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 全部つながるとは思わず、傘を出す場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋根の切れ目を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko iisiping tuloy-tuloy; pakisabi rin kung saan ilalabas ang payong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang putol sa bubong. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出口の手前に広い場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: May maluwag na lugar bago lumabas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで荷物を持ち直します。通路の真ん中では止まりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行外で荷物を整える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Doon ko aayusin ang paghawak ng gamit. Hindi ako hihinto sa gitna.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ayusin ang gamit sa labas ng daloy ng tao. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 歩く距離は少し長くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Mas mahaba nang kaunti ang lakad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近さより濡れにくさを選びます。バスは次の便でも構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 距離より雨回避を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mas pipiliin kong hindi mabasâ kaysa malapit. Ayos lang ang susunod na bus.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Piliing umiwas sa ulan kaysa lapit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口へ戻る予定はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありません。バス停までの片道を案内してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 片道の行先を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Wala. Pakituro ang isang direksiyon lamang hanggang hintuan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pupuntahang isang direksiyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この屋根の道で出口手前へどうぞ。そこで傘を準備し、横断案内からバス停へ進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito sa may bubong hanggang bago labasan. Ihanda ang payong doon, saka sundin ang gabay sa pagtawid patungong bus.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 平日は寮、週末は家族の家です。住所の手続きを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二住居の生活を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa dormitoryo kapag araw ng trabaho, sa pamilya tuwing katapusan ng linggo. Gusto kong itanong ang proseso ng tirahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang pamumuhay sa dalawang bahay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住み始めた時点を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 寮は今月一日からです。家族の家はその前からです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各開始時点を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa dormitoryo mula unang araw ngayong buwan. Sa pamilya, bago pa iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang simula ng bawat isa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 生活の状況を担当が確認します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勤務先が寮へ送る郵便だけで、住所が決まるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵送先だけで判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko iisiping tirahan na dahil lamang doon ipinadadala ng trabaho ang sulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag humatol sa pinadadalhan lamang. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族も寮へ移りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Lilipat din ang pamilya sa dormitoryo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いえ、私だけです。家族の届出を一緒に変えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族は移らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi, ako lamang. Hindi ko babaguhin kasabay ang rehistro nila.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi lilipat ang pamilya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 寮の所在地は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Alam mo ang tirahan ng dormitoryo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この資料です。二つの生活場所と開始日を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 所在地と実態を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ito ang dokumento. Hiwalay kong ipaliliwanag ang dalawang tinitirhan at petsa ng simula.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Isaayos ang lugar at aktuwal na pamumuhay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの住居の実態の相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。記入する住所は案内後に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ililipat sa tauhan ang tunay na paggamit ng dalawang bahay. Tiyakin ang isusulat na tirahan matapos ang gabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約変更の理由を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sabihin ang dahilan ng pagbabago ng reserbasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬が予約の前に足りなくなりそうです。早められるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬不足で早い予約を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Baka kulangin ang gamot bago ang takda. Gusto kong itanong kung maipapaaga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng mas maaga dahil maaaring kulangin ang gamot. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残りの記録はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋と数えたメモです。自分で飲む量を減らして延ばしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残数と指示未変更を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Supot at tala ng bilang. Hindi ko binawasan ang iniinom upang pahabain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang natitira at hindi binagong tagubilin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬の扱いは診療担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin sa tagagamot ang tungkol sa gamot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受診日の変更と薬の相談を二つとも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬相談と日時変更を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakisabi pareho ang pagbabago ng petsa at tanong sa gamot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang gamot at pagbabago ng oras. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水曜なら来られます。元の予約は確認前に取り消しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 候補と既予約維持を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Puwede ako sa Miyerkules. Hindi ko kakanselahin ang dati bago matiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang maaari at panatilihin ang dating reserbasyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から方法を案内します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残数と今の指示を見てもらい、予約結果も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指示と結果の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ipapasuri ko ang natitira at kasalukuyang tagubilin at titiyakin din ang resulta ng reserbasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Humiling ng pagtitiyak sa tagubilin at resulta. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 予約前の薬の不足懸念を担当へ引き継ぎます。服用や予約を自己変更せず案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ililipat ang alalahaning kulangin ang gamot bago ang takda. Huwag sariling magbago ng pag-inom o reserbasyon; sundin ang gabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車について伺います。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の自転車はここにありますが、隣の自転車と同じ錠でつながっていて出せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車体は存在するが別の錠で動かせないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Narito ang akin, pero iisang kandado ang nagdugtong sa katabing bisikleta kaya hindi mailabas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat na naroon ang bisikleta ngunit hindi maigalaw dahil sa ibang kandado. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その錠はご自身の物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa iyo ba ang kandadong iyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。誰が掛けたかは見ていません。隣の車体の持ち主が掛けたとも決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 錠が自分の物でなく掛けた人物も未確認と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi. Hindi ko nakita kung sino. Hindi ko rin iisiping may-ari ng katabi ang naglagay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi sariling kandado at hindi pa alam ang naglagay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 自分の車体だと確認できる情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: May patunay na iyo ang bisikleta?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 登録番号の控えがあります。自分の車体を示せても、別の錠を外す権限まであるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車体の所有情報と錠を外す権限を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: May kopya ako ng rehistro. Kahit mapatunayan ang sarili kong bisikleta, hindi ko iisiping may karapatang mag-alis ng ibang kandado.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pagmamay-ari at karapatang magtanggal ng kandado. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現場の様子は記録されていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真を撮りました。二台の位置と錠がどこを通っているかを残し、切ったり車体を引いたりしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 接続状態の写真と未切断未移動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nilitratuhan ko ang puwesto ng dalawa at daanan ng kandado. Hindi ko pinutol o hinila ang bisikleta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang larawan ng dugtong at hindi pagputol o paggalaw. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理者にも連絡できますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。持ち主へ連絡できるか管理者へ尋ねます。自分の鍵だけでは解決しないので、動かせない状態を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理者への連絡と動かせない状態の相談を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Itatanong ko kung makokontak ang may-ari. Hindi sapat ang susi ko, kaya gusto kong ikonsulta ang hindi maigalaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Humiling ng pakikipag-ugnayan sa tagapamahala at konsultasyon sa hindi maigalaw. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 車体の控えと現場の写真を確認します。管理者への連絡状況も伺い、別の錠が掛かっている状態について相談を受け付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Susuriin ang kopya ng rehistro at litrato. Itatanong din ang pakikipag-ugnayan sa tagapamahala at tatanggapin ang konsultasyon sa ibang kandado.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分宛ての封筒を一番外にしました。返信用だったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返信用を外側にした誤りを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ginawa kong pinakalabas ang sobreng para sa akin. Sobre pala iyon sa pagsagot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagkakamaling nasa labas ang sobreng pabalik. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出の案内を見せてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。提出先へ送る封筒は別に必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出案内で役割を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito po. Kailangan ng hiwalay na sobreng patungo sa pagsusumitihan, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Basahin ang papel ng mga sobre sa gabay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同封条件は提出先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin sa pagsusumitihan ang kundisyon ng pagsama sa loob.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この返信用は中へ入れ、外の宛先は提出先で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内外の宛先を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ilalagay ko sa loob ang pabalik at titiyakin sa tanggapan ang panlabas na tirahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang padadalhan sa loob at labas. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返信用の切手の指定もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: May itinakda ring selyo sa pabalik?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。外へ送る郵便料金と別に準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信切手と往路料金を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mayroon. Hiwalay kong ihahanda sa bayad ng papunta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang selyong pabalik at bayad na papunta. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類は揃っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。二つの宛先と料金を見直してから封を閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両封筒を確認して封を閉じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Rerepasuhin ko ang dalawang tirahan at bayad bago isara.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang dalawang sobre bago isara. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 提出先宛ての外封筒が整ってから配送条件を相談してください。返信用は案内に合わせて同封します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Kapag handa na ang panlabas na para sa tanggapan, ikonsulta ang paghahatid. Isama ang pabalik ayon sa gabay.
